heading: PokeSurvivor FAQ
intro: Quick answers about controls, saves, move slots, evolutions and collecting partners. For account problems, use the official game’s support options.

seo.title: PokeSurvivor FAQ - Controls, Saves and Game Help
seo.description: Find answers to PokeSurvivor questions about free play, controls, saves, co-op, move slots and evolutions. Know what to check before starting your next run.

questions: Is PokeSurvivor free to play?
Yes. You can play the official game in a browser without downloading a client. This fan guide is also free to browse.
How do I move and switch attacks?
Use WASD or the arrow keys to move, 1–4 or Q/E to switch your active move, and Esc to pause. On a phone or tablet, play in landscape, drag to move and tap a move to select it.
Do my attacks fire automatically?

Yes. The active slot triggers attacks automatically; other slots do not cast together unless combined by a Bond. Existing projectiles and timed buffs can persist after switching. Choice Band prevents ordinary slot switching while equipped.
Will guest progress be saved?

Guests do not keep permanent progress. With an account, changes are recorded in the current browser immediately, but cloud uploads require Save at the top right. There is no timed automatic cloud upload. Press Save and wait for confirmation before closing, clearing browser data or changing devices. A recent upload can briefly queue the next one. This fan site cannot recover a game save.
How do I evolve a move?
Reach level 5 with an eligible move and take its required stat card during that run. Then look for its gold evolution card. For example, Ember needs Power to evolve into Fire Blast.
Can I play PokeSurvivor with friends?
The game supports co-op for up to four players through its friends list and room invitations. Manage rooms and invitations inside the official game.
Does the 5-star guarantee give me a particular Pokémon?

No. Pity guarantees a rarity, not a species. Each regional banner tracks pity separately; at 69 pulls without a 5-star result, the next pull is guaranteed 5-star. Any 5-star result resets that banner’s counter.
Are ten single pulls the same as a ten-pull?
No. A ten-pull has a separate last-result guarantee if the first nine results contain no 4-star or 5-star Pokémon. Ten single pulls do not receive that batch guarantee.
Which partner should I try first?

Start with a partner whose opening attack is easy for you to aim while moving. Charmander, Squirtle and Bulbasaur introduce different attack styles. Use the Pokédex to compare their starting stats, then focus one evolution before spreading upgrades across several moves.
Does the tier list show the strongest Pokémon?

The upper board is your own ranking. Below it, our S–D recommendations cover species in the captured leaderboards, with current move routes, player discussions and dated results considered at comparable investment. Grades are editorial, not calculated from survival times. A capture date does not establish the build used for each run; Group times describe whole teams rather than individual strength.
What happens at minute 30?

The Judgment of Arceus begins at 30:00 once any current Rift or card choice has finished. Arceus is invulnerable: dodge its attacks and the escalating legendary waves. New Rifts stop opening at 28:00.
Is PokeSurvivor.me the official game website?
No. This is an independent fan guide. The game is hosted at pokesurvivor.com, which operates its own accounts, saves and multiplayer features.
Do physical and special attacks use the same stat?

No. Physical moves use physical attack and the target’s Defense; special moves use special attack and the target’s Special Defense. Swords Dance and Dragon Dance boost physical attacks, while Nasty Plot boosts special attacks. Check the selected partner in Level-up Cards.
Can I use a controller or aim manually?

Controllers can move, switch attacks, pause and operate menus; check Settings > Controls. On desktop, Manual aim in Settings > Accessibility is off by default and uses a mouse or right stick while attacks still fire automatically. Touch devices always auto-aim.
Can I change a partner’s starting move?

Yes. Buy Starting move for 400 coins in that partner’s Upgrades. You can then choose a non-buff move from its legal pool, or return to its default opening even when that is outside the ordinary pool. This guide shows defaults rather than your account selection.
Do single-type Pokémon get a damage bonus?
Yes. A partner with exactly one type deals 20% more damage with moves matching that type. Other move types do not receive it, and dual-type partners do not get this bonus.
Why does a co-op room keep reconnecting?

An invitation does not guarantee a working game connection. The current version offers TURN relay settings to eligible signed-in accounts, with direct STUN connections as fallback. Save first, load the current official game on every device, create a fresh room and try another host. A same-Wi-Fi or different-network test can narrow down the problem, but relay access and connection success are not guaranteed.
Why did a projectile upgrade leave me with one shot?

That issue affected twelve homing and bouncing moves in an older version. The released fix now gives the homing moves a second projectile at level 2 and a third at level 5; the bouncing moves gain a second projectile at level 5. Spread is corrected too. Save before refreshing the official game to load an update. Evolution requirements are unchanged.
What should I do if Save says pending or offline?

Stay on the device holding the new progress. Restore the connection if needed, press Save and wait for the game to confirm the upload. An upload within the last 65 seconds may queue another attempt rather than upload immediately. Avoid clearing site data or switching devices while changes remain pending. This fan site cannot inspect or repair your account.
I defeated a shiny. Why is it missing from my collection?

Check the same species, its Normal/Shiny control, collection filters and the account used for the capture. Then confirm Save completed on that device. In co-op, verify your own unlock rather than relying on a teammate’s result. A player report exists, but its cause is unconfirmed; these checks are not a promise of recovery.
Can I move the mobile buttons?

Yes. Open Settings > Controls > Place the buttons to reposition attacks, pause and the joystick; a fixed joystick is optional. This may improve the layout but is not a verified fix for every touch-input problem. Save before refreshing or changing browsers.
Can upgrades carry over to an evolved Pokémon?

Permanent upgrades are purchased separately for each species. Upgrading Charmander does not upgrade Charizard. Move evolution during a run is a different system. Try the partner before investing; the upgrade guide lists the price of every level.
What if I forget my game password?

The official game supports linking Gmail to a password account so Google sign-in can access that same account later. If you linked it previously, use the same Google account on the official site. Do not assume an unlinked Google account will recover a password account. For other cases, use the game operator’s support options; this fan site cannot reset passwords.
Can I move guest progress into an account?
Do not rely on transferring guest progress. The official online game warns that guest progress is not saved. Sign in before a collection run; this guide cannot transfer or restore a guest session.
Can I install or play offline?

The official browser game supports Add to Home Screen. The creator’s itch.io page also documents a solo offline download with browser-local saving. Co-op, cloud saves and leaderboards use the official online game. Independent Android ports can have different modes and rules; this guide covers the original game.
